name: Babylonia

categories.label: Score track total
categories.hint: Points are scored during play: Ziggurat contacts, Crop Fields, surrounded Cities (2 per matching Noble, plus City tile count), Ziggurat card bonuses.

categories.label: City tiles in front of you (tiebreaker)
categories.labelVi: Số thẻ City đang có (phá hòa)
categories.hint: Only used to break ties on points.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: most City tiles in front of them wins.
If still tied, the tied players share the victory.

endCondition.description: Ends immediately at the end of a turn when the active player has no Clan Tokens left on their Stand, or only one or no City remains on the board.

notes: family: area-majority. No separate final scoring; all points are tracked on the scoring track during play. Ziggurat cards may give an immediate 10 points or +1 point per two Cities scored (already included in the track). Optional variant: choose 7 of the 9 Ziggurat cards at random.
